kill.explanation: Provider capture preceded queued async checkpoint commit. Corrected harness observes durable state after SIGKILL; suspend explicitly waits for commit. No runtime durability/lease change.

laterMain.coverage: Later main changes are not automatically qualified by the frozen6d hosted experiment

limits: Owned local process failure over hosted storage with managed preview successor; not managed Vercel worker termination or database failover.
Synthetic fresh one-turn prose load; no browser UI/tool-callback load, production SLO or maximum-throughput claim.
Completed provider IDs/usage are not complete upstream retry/request-count telemetry. No surfaced throttle failure is not proof that no internal retry occurred.
Canonical snapshots are sampled; upload provenance is not independent remote byte attestation.
